content.title: Two-offer story chain
content.summary: Two people are offered each story step; the first completed line advances the chain.
content.setup: Invite participants, choose the start time, and set offer pairs for every step and fallback.
content.prompt: A mysterious package arrived at the station.
content.participant: If offered a step, read the current line and add one new line before its deadline, or decline.
content.access: This text example can stall if every offer for a step expires or is declined.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.
